issues.explanation: Domain writes (addMember/assignRole/removeMember/save/delete/transfer) are implemented directly in Livewire components with no app/Actions classes, contrary to domain-writes-go-through-Actions rule.
Public input properties lack #[Validate] attributes and use inline validate arrays; targetMembershipId has no validation rules at all, deviating from the #[Validate]+validate project pattern.
Ownership-transfer row locks are acquired outside the write transaction, so the demote-then-promote is not truly isolated against concurrent transfers.
Entity routes require auth+verified but the diff shows no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware registration, so verified may not be re-applied on Livewire update requests.

conventions.evidence: No app/Actions/* classes for domain writes; Livewire inputs use $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] (e.g. Members.php:127, Settings.php:267); otherwise policies for auth, generated-style migrations with down(), Fillable, audit channel, docs+CHANGELOG updated

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:membershipOf, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:save/delete/transfer small focused methods; clear names; Bulma/x- components; no dead code

requirements.evidence: migrations owner_seq+unique names (change.diff:794-798), Entity::getRouteKeyName slug, policies view/update/delete/manageSettings and membership view/assignRole/delete with owner/last-manager guards, EntityController pick Gate+session+audit+redirect, Dashboard/Members/Settings mount auth + locked entity, routes e/{entity:slug} and lang keys nav_members/nav_settings/transfer_title

scope.evidence: All hunks map to task: models/policies/migrations/factories, EntityController pick, Dashboard/Members/Settings + blades, routes, langs, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG, entity tests; no onboarding/switcher/middleware/navbar/billing extras

security.evidence: Every Livewire action calls $this->authorize (Members.php:125,156,180; Settings.php:265,293,315), membershipOf/target scoped to locked entity, {{ }} escaping, Fillable guards, owner row/last-manager denied; only nit is verified persistence

simplicity.evidence: Reuses x-entity-nav/x-form-field/x-button, Rule::enum(UserRole)->only(manageable()), scoped Eloquent queries; no service layers or speculative abstraction

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityDataModelTest.php, EntityMembersTest.php (forbidden add/assign/remove + foreign-id tamper), EntitySettingsTest.php (locked-entity tamper, demoted-owner save/delete denied, transfer edge cases), EntityPickTest.php, EntityPoliciesTest.php, EntityPagesTest.php

review.summary: Implements the full entity/membership model, policies, pick flow, and Livewire dashboard/members/settings with thorough Pest coverage. Main deductions are convention nits (no Actions, no #[Validate] attributes) and minor transfer-lock placement; approvable with nits.
